They are also sometimes used in research settings to understand the mechanisms of toxicity.

Alternatives to LD50 testing include *in vitro* methods (using cells or tissues in a laboratory setting) and *in silico* methods (computer modeling). These alternatives can provide valuable information about toxicity without the use of live animals.
